decisions.reason: As a recently launched sensor module in the firm’s core electronics area, it is likely to be retained because development costs are already sunk and any early weakness can still be framed as normal market ramp-up.
Because it had its own webpage and thus a more visible public commitment, management would be especially inclined to continue backing this industrial module rather than reverse course quickly.
This relay module fits the firm’s industrial electronics portfolio, and with only a short time on the market management would tend to persist instead of admitting a failed launch.

Although the server room monitoring kit looks somewhat more solution-oriented and potentially less central than the modules, it is still new enough that management would likely keep it on sale and attribute any weak uptake to temporary causes.
